title: Template-Constrained Fitting
summary: Restrict the human state to a statistical body-model manifold. Optimization, regression, and language-conditioned recovery can share this scaffold.
caveat: Complete articulation does not imply complete clothed geometry. This inventory also includes neighboring scene, garment, and RGB-D estimation systems.

title: Feature-Aligned Reconstruction
summary: Associate image evidence with 3D queries or primitives through projection, voxel features, stereo matching, or cross-view correspondence.
caveat: Supervised completion is learned from training data. Hybrids such as ECON and SIFU also use mechanisms discussed in other families.

rows.name: StereoPIFu
cells: Stereo cost volume and relative depth

rows.name: GPS-Gaussian
cells: Stereo depth and pixel-wise GS maps

rows.name: HaP
cells: Points guided by depth and SMPL

title: Canonical-Space Temporal Aggregation
summary: Register observations to a pose-neutral domain and accumulate reliable evidence over time.
caveat: Transient occlusion can be resolved by other frames; permanently unseen content needs additional assumptions. MonoNHR is a single-image structural counterpart, not temporal aggregation.

title: Generative-Prior-Guided Optimization
summary: Couple subject-specific reconstruction to generative guidance through image completion, 3D/UV completion, score distillation, observation synthesis, or iterative loops.
caveat: The inventory includes neighboring restoration methods. Guidance must remain anchored to valid evidence; photorealism alone does not establish identity fidelity.

title: Feed-Forward Generative Reconstruction
summary: Predict or sample subject-specific humans using shared learned models without per-subject parameter optimization.
caveat: Sampling can require repeated network evaluations. Fast prediction, complete geometry, calibrated uncertainty, and native animatability are different properties.

title: Conditional Generation
summary: Generate human geometry or appearance from semantic, identity, or latent conditions; also provide priors to reconstruction pipelines.
caveat: Conditional generation need not recover a particular observed subject. Body scaffolds and volumetric primitives do not automatically imply full clothed-surface recovery.

title: Datasets and Capture Resources
summary: Separate dataset content, input restriction, and reference fidelity before selecting an evaluation protocol.
caveat: Sp / Te / Qu / Co indicate spatial, temporal, quality, and coherence axes. Parentheses denote imposed restrictions. Counts have different units; fitted bodies and generated images are not ground-truth clothed geometry.
